subject: Marine Works - Chaleur - Miscou - south - MIRAMICHI, N.B.
text:
Marine Works - Chaleur - Miscou - south - MIRAMICHI, N.B.
To ensure the safety of both the public and workers,  all individuals traveling under the Centennial Bridge, Miramichi, N.B. are to use the Navigation Span as the only authorized passage.
The use of other spans may pose serious safety risks. Unauthorized access beneath non-navigation spans may interfere with ongoing work and expose individuals to potential hazards.
Caution.
